name: bug
description: Existing behaviour is incorrect or fails.

name: enhancement
description: New or expanded user-facing capability.

name: maintenance
description: Internal upkeep, refactoring, tooling or process work.

name: documentation
description: Documentation changes with no product behaviour change.

name: verification
description: Checks of implemented behaviour, with recorded evidence.

name: owner-action
description: Owner decision, legal information or external-account action.

name: needs-triage
description: Awaiting maintainer classification, priority or actionable scope.

name: needs-verification
description: Acceptance still needs live, platform or owner verification.

name: security
description: Credential, trust, privacy or command-execution risk.

name: dependencies
description: Dependency update pull requests, including Dependabot.

name: github_actions
description: GitHub Actions dependency update pull requests.

name: rust
description: Rust dependency update pull requests.

name: area:git
description: Repository operations, refs, diffs and working trees.

name: area:ui
description: Views, shared widgets, visual design and responsive layout.

name: area:accessibility
description: Keyboard access, focus, AccessKit and screen readers.

name: area:hosting
description: GitHub/GitLab APIs, accounts, requests and host metadata.

name: area:settings
description: Preferences, configuration controls and keybindings.

name: area:platform
description: Operating-system integration, installers and native updates.

name: area:security
description: Credential storage, trust boundaries, privacy and execution safety.

name: area:performance
description: Responsiveness, resource use, caching and benchmarks.

name: area:tests
description: Automated tests, quality guards and verification infrastructure.

name: area:docs
description: Repository documentation, contributor guidance and site content.

name: area:release
description: Build targets, packages, signing and release distribution.

name: area:planning
description: Project workflow, research decisions and backlog organisation.

name: area:legal
description: Terms, privacy notices, licensing and legal identity.

name: area:app
description: Application startup, session state and cross-cutting app behaviour.

name: priority:p0-critical
description: Confirmed critical incident or release blocker; address immediately.

name: priority:p1-high
description: High-priority work; address before normal backlog.

name: priority:p2-normal
description: Normal planned work and default priority pending triage.

name: priority:p3-low
description: Deferred or low-impact work after higher priorities.

name: size:small
description: One bounded correction or focused verification; little coordination.

name: size:medium
description: Several related changes or checks within one workflow.

name: size:large
description: Cross-module/platform work, a broad audit or a compound feature.

name: size:needs-estimate
description: Scope or external dependencies are too unclear to estimate remaining work.

name: duplicate
description: Same deliverable as a linked canonical issue; close and track work there.
